log_level.description: Verbosity of logs: Debug, Info, Notice, Warn, Error, etc.

pid_file.description: Path to file where istgt will write its process ID.

control_socket.description: Path to UNIX socket for remote administration.

allow_remote.description: Whether to enable remote management via the control socket.

max_connections.description: Maximum total number of simultaneous iSCSI connections.

io_timeout.description: I/O operation timeout in seconds. Increase for slow disks or high latency.

preallocate_memory.description: Preallocate buffers for data I/O (improves latency but uses more memory).

luns.description: List of storage LUNs exposed by this target. Each must be a Disk (file or block device).

path.description: Path to the underlying file or block device (e.g., /dev/sdb or /var/lib/istgt/vdisk0).

read_only.description: If true, writes to this LUN are blocked.

serial.description: Unique serial number for the storage device (must be unique per LUN).

portals.description: List of network portals (IP:port pairs) on which to listen. Discovery setting controls whether portal appears in discovery responses.

discovery.description: If true, portal is included in discovery responses.

allowed_initiators.description: List of allowed initiator IQNs (empty = allow all initiators). Use * for wildcard.

auth_users.description: List of CHAP credentials for mutual authentication (empty = no authentication).

target_name.description: Unique iSCSI target name (must follow IQN format: iqn.yyyy-mm.naming-authority:unique-name).

queue_depth.description: Maximum I/O operations queued per connection. Increase for high throughput workloads.

data_digest.description: Digest algorithm for data payload integrity. Options: CRC32C, None.

header_digest.description: Digest algorithm for iSCSI header integrity. Options: CRC32C, None.

default_block_size.description: Fallback block size for LUNs where detection fails. Typically 512.

login_timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for iSCSI login to complete (seconds).

max_connections_per_session.description: Maximum number of connections allowed per iSCSI session.

send_target_name.description: Include TargetName in login response (required for most initiators).

suppress_target_name.description: If true, suppress TargetName in discovery responses (advanced use only).
